import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind, Modality

class TotalChargesCleaner(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    """
    清理包含空白符或脏字符的total_charges列并转换为浮点型，缺失值默认为0。
    """
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TotalChargesCleaner",
        kind=OperatorKind.IMPUTER,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="清理包含空白符的total_charges列并转换为浮点型",
        conditions=["数据存在字符串格式的数值列", "存在包含空白字符的缺失值"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy", "sklearn"],
        params={"col": "total_charges"},
        parent="TotalChargesCleaner@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, col="total_charges"):
        self.col = col

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        if self.col in X.columns:
            # 根据Lesson:69d51358经验：先strip，再转数值（强制转换空值），最后填充缺失值
            X[self.col] = pd.to_numeric(
                X[self.col].astype(str).str.strip(), 
                errors="coerce"
            ).fillna(0.0)
            
            # 确保转换后没有无穷值，保持特征稳定性
            X[self.col] = X[self.col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0)
            
        return X

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class TenureBucketizer(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TenureBucketizer",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="将数值型在网时长特征划分为业务导向的区间，增强线性模型的解释性。",
        conditions=["输入必须包含数值型tenure列"],
        dependencies=["numpy", "pandas", "sklearn"],
        params={"col": "tenure"},
        parent="TenureBucketizer@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, col="tenure"):
        self.col = col

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        """记录算子状态，本算子为无状态转换，仅返回self。"""
        self.bins_ = [-1, 6, 12, 24, 48, np.inf]
        self.labels_ = ["0-6", "6-12", "12-24", "24-48", "48+"]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        """
        将tenure列分桶，处理缺失值及非数值情况。
        遵循数据清洗规范：先处理潜在脏数据，确保输出类型一致。
        """
        X = X.copy()
        
        # 处理脏数据：先确保转为数值，无法转换的(含空值)处理为-1（即处于0-6区间内）
        raw_tenure = pd.to_numeric(X[self.col].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
        raw_tenure = raw_tenure.fillna(-1)
        
        # 分桶操作
        bucket_col = f"{self.col}_bucket"
        X[bucket_col] = pd.cut(
            raw_tenure, 
            bins=self.bins_, 
            labels=self.labels_
        ).astype(str)
        
        # 确保分桶后的缺失值被处理（pd.cut可能在NaN输入下产生nan字符串）
        X[bucket_col] = X[bucket_col].replace("nan", "0-6")
        
        return X

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind, Modality

class ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    """
    生成消费比值特征：月均消费(total/tenure) / 当前月费。
    衡量客户长期平均消费水平与当前资费水平的差异，用于捕捉流失倾向。
    """
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="基于月费、总费及在网时长构造比值特征，衡量资费变动。",
        conditions=["输入列包含 monthly_charges, total_charges, tenure"],
        dependencies=["numpy", "pandas", "sklearn"],
        params={
            "monthly": "monthly_charges",
            "total": "total_charges",
            "tenure": "tenure"
        },
        parent="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, monthly="monthly_charges", total="total_charges", tenure="tenure"):
        self.monthly = monthly
        self.total = total
        self.tenure = tenure

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        self.is_fitted_ = True
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()

        def clean_numeric(series):
            # 严格处理：先转字符串，去除空格，再转数值，强制coerce无法转换的为NaN
            if series.dtype == 'object':
                series = series.astype(str).str.strip()
                # 排除可能存在的空字符串，将其视为 NaN
                series = series.replace(r'^\s*$', np.nan, regex=True)
                series = pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce')
            else:
                series = pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce')
            return series.fillna(0.0)

        # 获取并清洗数据
        monthly_series = clean_numeric(X[self.monthly])
        total_series = clean_numeric(X[self.total])
        tenure_series = clean_numeric(X[self.tenure])

        # 计算 avg = total / tenure。
        # tenure 为 0 时结果为 inf，后续统一处理
        with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
            avg_series = total_series / tenure_series
            # 计算 ratio = avg / monthly
            ratio = avg_series / monthly_series

        # 处理 inf, -inf 和 NaN，保证鲁棒性
        # 如果无法计算（例如 tenure 或 monthly 均为 0），默认填充 1.0 代表比率持平
        ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        ratio = ratio.fillna(1.0)
        
        # 将结果赋值回数据框
        X["charge_ratio"] = ratio
        
        return X

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class KFoldTargetEncoder(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="KFoldTargetEncoder",
        kind=OperatorKind.ENCODER,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="基于K折交叉验证的高基数类别目标编码，支持平滑处理以防止过拟合。",
        conditions=["数据包含类别特征", "目标变量为二分类"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "sklearn", "numpy"],
        params={"columns": None, "n_splits": 5, "smoothing": 10.0},
        parent="KFoldTargetEncoder@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, columns=None, n_splits=5, smoothing=10.0):
        self.columns = columns
        self.n_splits = n_splits
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.mapping_ = {}
        self.prior_ = None

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        X = X.copy()
        if self.columns is None:
            self.columns = X.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'category']).columns.tolist()
        
        target = y.name if isinstance(y, pd.Series) else "target"
        df = X.copy()
        df[target] = y
        self.prior_ = df[target].mean()

        for col in self.columns:
            self.mapping_[col] = {}
            # 计算全量统计用于测试集映射
            stats = df.groupby(col)[target].agg(["mean", "count"])
            smooth = (stats["mean"] * stats["count"] + self.prior_ * self.smoothing) / (stats["count"] + self.smoothing)
            self.mapping_[col]["global"] = smooth
            
            # 计算训练集K折编码
            kf = KFold(n_splits=self.n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
            train_enc = pd.Series(index=df.index, dtype=float)
            for fit_idx, val_idx in kf.split(df):
                fold_stats = df.iloc[fit_idx].groupby(col)[target].agg(["mean", "count"])
                fold_smooth = (fold_stats["mean"] * fold_stats["count"] + self.prior_ * self.smoothing) / (fold_stats["count"] + self.smoothing)
                train_enc.iloc[val_idx] = df.iloc[val_idx][col].map(fold_smooth)
            
            self.mapping_[col]["train_enc"] = train_enc
        
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        for col in self.columns:
            if col in self.mapping_:
                # 训练集返回K折编码，测试集返回全局平均编码
                if X.index.equals(self.mapping_[col]["train_enc"].index):
                    X[col] = self.mapping_[col]["train_enc"]
                else:
                    X[col] = X[col].map(self.mapping_[col]["global"])
                
                # 处理未见类别和缺失值
                X[col] = X[col].fillna(self.prior_)
                # 确保无无穷值
                X[col] = X[col].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], self.prior_)
        
        return X

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind, Modality

class ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    """
    生成消费比值特征：月均消费(total/tenure) / 当前月费。
    衡量客户长期平均消费水平与当前资费水平的差异，用于捕捉流失倾向。
    """
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="基于月费、总费及在网时长构造比值特征，衡量资费变动。",
        conditions=["输入列包含 monthly_charges, total_charges, tenure"],
        dependencies=["numpy", "pandas", "sklearn"],
        params={
            "monthly": "monthly_charges",
            "total": "total_charges",
            "tenure": "tenure"
        },
        parent="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, monthly="monthly_charges", total="total_charges", tenure="tenure"):
        self.monthly = monthly
        self.total = total
        self.tenure = tenure

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        self.is_fitted_ = True
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()

        def clean_numeric(series):
            # 严格处理：先转字符串，去除空格，再转数值，强制coerce无法转换的为NaN
            if series.dtype == 'object':
                series = series.astype(str).str.strip()
                # 排除可能存在的空字符串，将其视为 NaN
                series = series.replace(r'^\s*$', np.nan, regex=True)
                series = pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce')
            else:
                series = pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce')
            return series.fillna(0.0)

        # 获取并清洗数据
        monthly_series = clean_numeric(X[self.monthly])
        total_series = clean_numeric(X[self.total])
        tenure_series = clean_numeric(X[self.tenure])

        # 计算 avg = total / tenure。
        # tenure 为 0 时结果为 inf，后续统一处理
        with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
            avg_series = total_series / tenure_series
            # 计算 ratio = avg / monthly
            ratio = avg_series / monthly_series

        # 处理 inf, -inf 和 NaN，保证鲁棒性
        # 如果无法计算（例如 tenure 或 monthly 均为 0），默认填充 1.0 代表比率持平
        ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        ratio = ratio.fillna(1.0)
        
        # 将结果赋值回数据框
        X["charge_ratio"] = ratio
        
        return X

lessons.title: 逻辑回归标准化与可解释性
lessons.trigger: 使用逻辑回归模型，或者需要模型具有高可解释性时
lessons.fix: 必须先进行特征标准化（如 StandardFeatureScaler），在 0.1~10 之间搜索正则化强度 C，可直接输出系数给业务方。

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低
lessons.trigger: 流失场景存在正负样本不平衡，模型默认阈值或未配置样本权重时召回率达不到业务要求
lessons.fix: 启用平衡类权重（如 class_weight='balanced' 或 BalancedLightGBMClassifier）以提升召回率

lessons.title: 数值列含空白字符导致类型转换失败
lessons.trigger: 新入网客户累计消费为空白字符串，读取为 object 类型，转 float 时抛出 ValueError: could not convert string to float: ' '
lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: 随机森林防过拟合与召回优化
lessons.trigger: 使用随机森林模型，面临过拟合风险，或业务要求召回优先时
lessons.fix: 设置 n_estimators 300 左右，限制 max_depth 在 8~16 防止过拟合；召回优先时需配合调整分类阈值。

lessons.title: 预测阶段出现未见类别导致编码报错
lessons.trigger: 线上/测试集出现未见类别，OneHotEncoder 抛出 ValueError: Found unknown categories
lessons.fix: 编码器配置 handle_unknown='ignore' 或 infrequent_if_exist 忽略未知类别
